title: Roseau Cathedral

terrainReference.basis: Original terrain just outward from the historic tower portal. The entrance and retaining grade are approximate.

mapIdentity.provider: OpenStreetMap way 361451997 supplies the native outline and the projecting tower front. The Diocese of Roseau documents the historical central stone tower, spire and façade development.

identities.name: Roseau Cathedral
identities.mappedName: Our Lady of Fair Haven Cthedral

mapIdentity.scope: OpenStreetMap way 361451997 defines the connected 16-corner cathedral and projecting central tower. The tower’s three arcades, upper windows and tall spire follow the December 2008 exterior.

note: The 2008 public-domain view establishes the Gothic portal, weathered stone, pale niche figures, clock, short white-domed turret and pre-replacement spire. The rear and precise roof sections are approximate. The hillside source elevation field remains intact.
